payload.description: fgos run --writes refuses every writing unit with binding-replay-config-mismatch on design-lap release e93ccc3f (source 746097053, activated 2026-11-22). The main checkout's tracked .fgos/config.yaml is unchanged against HEAD, and the worktree carries the same config.yaml. So the digest the bind records (src/runner/dispatch/assignment-runner.mjs ~line 305, seatConfigDigest of the caller's live config) and the replay's loadRunnerConfigForDir(root) seem to read different layers (global ~/.fgos/config.yaml or accounts, or main root against worktree). Effect: no writing Unit can run through the primary door on this machine.
